rules.description: Whole-word match. Fires on 'BANNEDWORDONE' but NOT on 'BANNEDWORDONEXTRA', because whole-word matching compares tokens rather than substrings.
Multi-word phrase. Matches a contiguous run of tokens, so punctuation and extra spacing between the words do not defeat it.
Substring match, which is far more false-positive prone. The exception keeps 'SAFEBANNEDWORDTWO' from triggering it.
Regex rules are matched against the NORMALIZED transcript (lowercased, punctuation folded to spaces). They can only be defined in this file, never through /moderation add. Disabled by default.
